# STOX Energy Socks

> > Premium graduated compression socks and athletic wear engineered with innovative Dryarn® and Merino wool technology for performance, recovery, and everyday circulation support.

STOX Energy Socks specializes in medical-grade and performance compression hosiery designed for athletes, travelers, and individuals seeking circulatory health benefits. The brand combines European manufacturing excellence with advanced fabric technologies including proprietary Dryarn® material and natural Merino wool.

## Key Topics

- Graduated compression technology
- Dryarn® fabric
- Merino wool
- Compression class 2
- Athletic recovery
- Blood circulation support
- Degressive compression
- Medical-grade compression
- Running socks
- Hiking socks
- Cycling socks
- Travel socks
- Restless Legs Syndrome
- European manufacturing
- DHL shipping
